transforms.name: recency
transforms.effect: classifyMonitorRecency returns fresh or stale from evidence age. No clock is not stale.

transforms.name: is-stale
transforms.effect: isStale is false for idle, for an open root tool, and when no clock exists. Otherwise it is the recency result. derive always writes the boolean.

transforms.name: peer-standing
transforms.effect: For another device, window-rows replaces that boolean with standing !== live. A self row keeps isStale.

transport.name: isStale
transport.contract: host or replica supplies the row property
